sources.kinematicViscosity: Seawater at 15 °C, m²/s (ITTC 2011, Fresh Water and Seawater Properties, 7.5-02-01-03)
sources.transitionReynolds: Below about 5·10⁵ the flow along a plate stays laminar (Schlichting, Boundary-Layer Theory) and the ITTC-1957 line no longer holds; slower than that it is read at the transition
sources.formFactor: A slender round-bilged small craft's form factor 1 + k is 1.1 to 1.3 on the ITTC-1957 line (Molland, Turnock & Hudson 2011, Ship Resistance and Propulsion)
sources.bowDrag: A fine bow adds no drag of its own beyond the form factor; a blunt one sets its own, on beam by draft
sources.sideDrag: A round-bilged hull's section in cross-flow has a drag coefficient of 0.6 to 1.0 (Faltinsen 1990, Sea Loads on Ships and Offshore Structures, ch. 6), lowered by the finite length of the hull (Hoerner 1965, Fluid-Dynamic Drag, ch. 3)
